classification_detail: 1 sorry: ac_monotone_maps_null_to_null. Proven helpers: monotone_image_interval, monotone_image_Icc. Blocked by: open subset decomposition into disjoint intervals (not in Mathlib).

sorry_locations: ac_monotone_maps_null_to_null (main theorem: null set image under AC monotone map)
blockers: Open subset decomposition: every open subset of ℝ is a countable union of disjoint open intervals. This standard real analysis fact is not available as a packaged lemma in Mathlib, and is the single missing ingredient connecting the outer-regularity null-set cover to the finite AC condition.
